            if (prob + 1e-8 >= d) {
                out.println(i);
                break;
            }
            i++;
        }
        out.flush();
    }

    static class FastScanner {
        private final Reader in;
        private int pending;
        private boolean hasPending;

        FastScanner() {
            in = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in), 32768);
            pending = -1;
            hasPending = false;
        }

        private int read() throws IOException {
            if (hasPending) {
                hasPending = false;
                return pending;
            }
            return in.read();
        }

        private int peek() throws IOException {
            if (!hasPending) {
                pending = in.read();
                hasPending = true;
            }
            return pending;
        }

        private boolean delimiter(int c) {
            return c == ' ' || c == '\t' || c == '\n' || c == '\r' || c == '\f';
        }

        private void skipWhitespace() throws IOException {
            int c = peek();
            while (c >= 0 && delimiter(c)) {
                read();
                c = peek();
            }
        }

        String next() {
            try {
                skipWhitespace();
                StringBuilder sb = new StringBuilder();
                int c = peek();
                while (c >= 0 && !delimiter(c)) {
                    sb.append((char) c);
                    read();
                    c = peek();
                }
                return sb.toString();
            } catch (IOException e) {
                throw new RuntimeException(e);
            }
        }

        int nextInt() {
            return Integer.parseInt(next());
        }

        double nextDouble() {
            return Double.parseDouble(next());
        }
    }
